title: Removing the fixed coordinate
statement: For a nonnegative integer $k$ and a coordinate $i$ among $k+1$ coordinates, the sign vectors of length $k+1$ with coordinate $i$ fixed at $1$ are in bijection with sign vectors of length $k$. The bijection deletes coordinate $i$, and its inverse inserts $1$ at coordinate $i$.
